<document id="check-deposit-how">
DepositingˆaˆcheckˆinˆtheˆappˆYouˆcanˆdepositˆpaperˆchecksˆbyˆtakingˆaˆphotoˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆdepositˆ1.ˆSignˆtheˆbackˆofˆtheˆcheck.ˆ2.ˆUnderˆyourˆsignature,ˆwriteˆ"ForˆmobileˆdepositˆonlyˆatˆTallowbrook".ˆ3.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆDepositˆaˆcheck.ˆ4.ˆEnterˆtheˆamountˆandˆphotographˆtheˆfrontˆandˆbackˆonˆaˆdarkˆsurface.ˆ##ˆLimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆDailyˆmobileˆcheckˆdepositˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$1,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$2,500ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆKeepˆtheˆcheckˆKeepˆtheˆpaperˆcheckˆforˆ14ˆdaysˆafterˆit'sˆdeposited,ˆthenˆdestroyˆit.ˆDon'tˆdepositˆtheˆsameˆcheckˆanywhereˆelse.ˆ##ˆChecksˆweˆcan'tˆacceptˆChecksˆmadeˆoutˆtoˆsomeoneˆelse,ˆchecksˆfromˆoutsideˆtheˆUS,ˆmoneyˆorders,ˆandˆchecksˆwithoutˆtheˆendorsementˆabove.ˆ##ˆWhenˆtheˆmoneyˆisˆavailableˆSeeˆ"Whenˆcheckˆdepositsˆareˆavailable".ˆTheˆappˆshowsˆtheˆreleaseˆdateˆafterˆyouˆsubmitˆtheˆdeposit.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="wires-domestic">
SendingˆaˆdomesticˆwireˆDomesticˆwiresˆsendˆmoneyˆtoˆanotherˆUSˆbankˆaccountˆonˆtheˆsameˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆHowˆtoˆsendˆaˆwireˆ1.ˆTapˆTransfers,ˆthenˆWire.ˆ2.ˆEnterˆtheˆrecipient'sˆname,ˆbankˆroutingˆnumber,ˆaccountˆnumberˆandˆaddress.ˆ3.ˆReviewˆtheˆfeeˆandˆconfirmˆwithˆyourˆpasscode.ˆ##ˆCutoffˆWiresˆsubmittedˆbeforeˆ3:00ˆPMˆETˆonˆaˆbusinessˆdayˆareˆsentˆtheˆsameˆday.ˆLaterˆwiresˆareˆsentˆtheˆnextˆbusinessˆday.ˆ##ˆFeesˆandˆlimitsˆ|ˆPlanˆ|ˆFeeˆ|ˆDailyˆlimitˆ|ˆ|---|---|---|ˆ|ˆBasicˆ|ˆ$25.00ˆ|ˆ$5,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPlusˆ|ˆ$15.00ˆ|ˆ$10,000ˆ|ˆ|ˆPremiumˆ|ˆfreeˆ|ˆ$25,000ˆ|ˆ##ˆBeforeˆyouˆsendˆWiresˆcan'tˆbeˆcancelledˆonceˆsent.ˆDouble-checkˆtheˆdetails,ˆandˆbeˆcarefulˆifˆsomeoneˆyou'veˆonlyˆmetˆonline,ˆorˆsomeoneˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆaˆbankˆorˆtheˆgovernment,ˆasksˆyouˆtoˆwireˆmoney.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="security-scams">
CommonˆscamsˆtoˆwatchˆforˆTheseˆareˆtheˆscamsˆweˆseeˆmostˆoften.ˆKnowingˆthemˆisˆtheˆbestˆprotection.ˆ##ˆFakeˆbankˆcallsˆSomeoneˆcallsˆclaimingˆtoˆbeˆfromˆTallowbrook'sˆfraudˆteam.ˆTheyˆknowˆsomeˆofˆyourˆdetailsˆandˆsayˆyourˆaccountˆisˆatˆrisk.ˆTheyˆaskˆforˆaˆcodeˆorˆaskˆyouˆtoˆmoveˆmoney.ˆThat'sˆaˆscam.ˆWeˆneverˆdoˆthat.ˆ##ˆImpersonatingˆsomeoneˆyouˆknowˆAˆmessageˆfromˆaˆ"familyˆmember"ˆwithˆaˆnewˆnumberˆwhoˆurgentlyˆneedsˆmoney.ˆCallˆthemˆonˆtheirˆoldˆnumberˆbeforeˆyouˆsendˆanything.ˆ##ˆMarketplaceˆandˆrentalˆscamsˆAˆsellerˆasksˆyouˆtoˆpayˆbyˆBrookPayˆorˆwireˆinsteadˆofˆaˆprotectedˆpaymentˆmethod,ˆoftenˆforˆaˆdealˆthatˆseemsˆtooˆgood.ˆBrookPayˆandˆwiresˆcan'tˆbeˆreversed.ˆ##ˆJobˆandˆinvestmentˆscamsˆSomeoneˆoffersˆeasyˆmoneyˆforˆmovingˆfundsˆthroughˆyourˆaccount,ˆorˆpromisesˆguaranteedˆreturns.ˆMovingˆmoneyˆforˆothersˆcanˆgetˆyourˆaccountˆclosed.ˆ##ˆWhatˆtoˆdoˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆyou'veˆbeenˆscammed,ˆmessageˆusˆstraightˆaway.ˆTheˆsoonerˆweˆknow,ˆtheˆbetterˆtheˆchanceˆofˆstoppingˆorˆrecoveringˆtheˆmoney,ˆalthoughˆweˆcan'tˆpromiseˆthat.ˆSeeˆ"Ifˆyouˆsentˆmoneyˆtoˆaˆscammer".ˆStillˆstuck?ˆChatˆwithˆusˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆSomeoneˆisˆthereˆaroundˆtheˆclock.
</document>
</documents>
